content: pandas 3.0.0 released 2026-01-21 with breaking changes (str dtype default, copy-on-write default, datetime us resolution, groupby unobserved groups); official migration path is 2.3 first. Latest: pandas 2.3.3 (requires >=3.9), 3.0.6 (requires >=3.11). numpy 2.5.3 latest (requires >=3.12), 2.4.x line available. Repo scripts: get_task_performance.py stdlib-only, summarize_comparison.py uses numpy+pandas — CI must pin pandas <3 to avoid silent behavior change.
